activity_summary: You sat the fish-day board and ate it. The loaf was a finger and a half short, at a penny, and the board was threepence. The firing sixpence stayed off the slate. Verbeke went to his own work under his own name. The one bough is still the allowance. You did not tell the table about Sunday.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Measured the loaf, kept the firing off the slate, and took the threepence in the eating.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Ate, and did not tell her about Sunday.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Laid the short loaf, and had not brought a second bough.

entities.name: Gillis Verbeke
entities.context: Went to his own work under his own name.

facets.activity: Ate the board and did not mention Sunday
